reviewed.reasoning: Audited conditional mean/median/quantile loss objectives, one-sided quantile derivatives with atoms and bounded difference quotients, binary Brier excess including endpoints, finite categorical log divergence/equality with zero support, and outcome-weighted probability transformation. Reviewed exact population calibration/resolution decomposition, overall versus conditional/subgroup calibration, sharpness and random skill-denominator caveat; continuous/randomized-discrete transform conditions and separation from serial calibration. Checked finite-state information-value bounds, unchanged-action/payoff/ignore-option assumptions, monetary versus nonlinear utility fees, and state-independent garbling emulation. Audited sigma-algebra generation/measurability/null-event changes and probability continuity; simple/nonnegative/signed integral construction, dyadic monotonicity, direct monotone proof, Fatou, signed dominated convergence and countable interchange. Reviewed Cauchy–Schwarz integrability, L1/L2 completeness by summable subsequences/Fatou, closed information subspace, parallelogram minimizing projection, indicator identities, positivity/uniqueness, L1 contraction/truncation extension, tower and bounded known-factor proof. Audited adapted/predictable/stopping definitions, bounded stopped-increment identity and non-uniformly-integrable doubling counterexample. Independently checked the full integrable iid strong-law sequence: summable index-level truncation events, universal 2 E|X| weighted variance bound, first-crossing maximal inequality, summable chosen tail events, pathwise Cauchy series, proved finite Kronecker identity/Cesàro lemma, expectation convergence and finite discarded prefixes.
reviewed.arithmetic: Independent exact joint group/event enumeration, calibration/resolution/score calculations and all-report-grid conditional optima; direct binary/categorical logarithmic averages; a random-normalization incentive counterexample; weighted-Brier and all-point-loss objectives on rational action grids. Exhaustive state/signal and all deterministic policies verify information values, posteriors, action thresholds, fees, unchanged decisions and an entire grid of garbling channels. Exact weighted partitions verify all information-event integrals, projection error identity, moments/total variance and coarsening. Finite dyadic partition sums, all two-sign martingale/stop/hindsight histories and up to 4,096 doubling histories verify stopped and absolute/tail expectations. Independent finite-cutoff quadrature and reciprocal-tail substitution verify Pareto moments/tails; numerical truncation-bound diagnostics, unrelated exact Kronecker sequences and exhaustive unequal-increment first-crossing partitions complement the written general proofs.
reviewed.solutions: Solved all sixteen exercise prompts. Checked probability versus action/loss distinctions, dollar/squared-dollar units, quantile mass conditions, report-conditioning versus pre-purchase averaging, policy and garbled-signal comparisons. Verified finite sigma-algebra measurability, countable dense null indicator versus Riemann failure, simple approximations/spikes, signed-series domination, unequal-weight conditional forecasts and variance identities, stop measurability/hindsight counterexample, doubling uniform-integrability failure, and infinite-variance iid sample-mean proof with no claimed root-n normal rate. Open forecasting critique has explicit criteria addressing selection, unavailable vintages, finite calibration, serial dependence and decision costs.
reviewed.instruction: Point and distribution forecasts are distinguished before proper scoring, and proper probabilities before purchase decisions. Conditioning/tower from Chapter 5 motivates formal information-event identities. Integration construction and convergence precede completeness, conditional existence and series convergence. Every method required in an exercise is proved, explained or documented in prerequisites. Conditional existence is established by projection and L1 truncation rather than silently invoking an unproved density representation. Lebesgue measure extension, product-measure/Fubini construction, regular conditional distribution existence and unbounded stopping extensions are clearly identified as standard further-study results; continuous-time stochastic integration is reserved for later finance instruction.
reviewed.sources: Retrieved original author-hosted Gneiting–Raftery scoring article, official Duke information-value handout, Tao integration/strong-law notes and Dembo's author-hosted 2021 probability notes. Inspected the relevant scoring/quantile/skill, perfect/imperfect utility/fee, integration-limit/series, sigma-finite product, conditional projection and predictable/stopped-process sections. Added four accurately scoped source entries. Failed legacy PDF URLs are not used as inspected evidence. Prose, synthetic laws, exercises and numerical comparisons are original; common mathematical proof techniques are attributed through further-study routes.
reviewed.structure: Each chapter contains two worked examples, eight exercises and eight complete solutions, formal assumptions, boundary/counterexamples, teach-back and delayed check. Integrated build and structural/citation/link/anchor review passed for all 36 available manuscripts and 43 HTML pages. Previous forecasting successor routes now link to the real manuscripts. Chapter 6's general integrable strong-law statement/solution now links to the full Chapter 12 proof. Volume 3 assessment remains clearly in production.
